title: Hidden climate superpower: Why some ocean “snow” carries six times more carbon
caption:
It turns out the stickiness of marine snow is the secret to carbon storage. New research shows that gooey particles resist bacterial decay, allowing them to carry six times more carbon to the deep ocean floor.

Source: Sciencedaily - Hidden climate superpower: Why some ocean “snow” carries six times more carbon

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261105224558.htm
